svg.title: Six Animated Certificates — GitHub Profile Gallery
svg.desc: Six certificates displayed in two rows of animated, purple-edged 3D cards. First: Oracle Gen AI Professional Certification; second: Oracle Agentic AI Foundations Associate; followed by Google IT Support: Bits and Bytes of Computer Networking, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Career Essentials in Generative AI by Microsoft and LinkedIn, and HackerRank Software Engineer Certification.
